title: Affine morphism with isomorphic global sections is an isomorphism
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. If the induced ring map on global sections $\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ is an isomorphism, then $f$ is an isomorphism of schemes.
